title: LLLMs: A Data-Driven Survey of Evolving Research on Limitations of Large Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Topic modeling (HDBSCAN, BERTopic, and LlooM) and trend analysis of academic paper abstracts to quantify the prevalence and evolution of research on social bias, fairness, gender, racial, and demographic disparities in LLMs.

Clustering and trend analysis of academic literature to identify and track research focused on language and cultural limitations, including cross-lingual and cross-cultural performance disparities in LLMs.
